summary:
Hand #1 · blinds 10/20 · P0 has the button
P1 posts small blind 10
P2 posts big blind 20
P0 raises to 300 and is all in
P1 raises to 1,000 and is all in
P2 calls 980 and is all in
P0 shows A♠ A♥
P1 shows K♦ K♥
P2 shows Q♣ Q♠
Everyone agreed to run it twice
First board, Flop: 9♠ 7♠ 2♥
First board, Turn: 9♠ 7♠ 2♥ 3♣
First board, River: 9♠ 7♠ 2♥ 3♣ 4♦
Second board, Flop: A♣ Q♦ 8♥
Second board, Turn: A♣ Q♦ 8♥ 5♣
Second board, River: A♣ Q♦ 8♥ 5♣ 6♠
P0 wins 450 from the main pot on the first board with Pair of Aces
P0 wins 450 from the main pot on the second board with Three of a Kind, Aces
P1 wins 700 from side pot 1 on the first board with Pair of Kings
P2 wins 700 from side pot 1 on the second board with Three of a Kind, Queens
